## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:`disabledActions` 字段说明里"在 Setup › Packaged automation 关掉"改为 Setup › Packaged Actions,并重新生成两页 API 参考文档。
- 为什么改:Packaged automation 页面已退役,管理员照着已发布的 API 参考去找会找不到;packaged action 的开关现在在 Setup 的 Packaged Actions。
- 风险与回滚:只改文字,字段形状、何时出现、ACTION_DISABLED 错误码都不变;回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看:packages/spec/src/api/protocol.zod.ts(disabledActions 的 describe 一行)、content/docs/references/api/app-bundle.mdx。
- 两分钟验证:`git grep -n -i 'packaged automation' -- packages/spec content/docs/references` 应无命中。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

- `packages/spec/src/api/protocol.zod.ts`: the `disabledActions` `.describe()` now says an administrator turned the actions off under **Setup › Packaged Actions** (the `nav_packaged_actions` entry's label in `packages/platform-objects/src/apps/setup-nav.contributions.ts`), not the retired Setup › Packaged automation page. The same spelling the sibling #29374 PR (#29476) gives the `ACTION_DISABLED` refusal sentence.
- Regenerated `content/docs/references/api/protocol.mdx` (1 row) and `content/docs/references/api/app-bundle.mdx` (5 rows) through `check:generated --fix`, which proved only `check:docs` stale.
- `.changeset/29446-disabled-actions-packaged-actions.md`: `@objectstack/spec` patch.

That was the only spec occurrence: `git grep -n -i 'packaged automation' -- packages/spec` returns nothing on this head. Not `packages/types` (#29374's half, PR #29476).
